# Placement

> Grid building placement for tycoons, base builders and farms.

- Package: `Placement` · Category: Gameplay & world
- Starts at server boot: **yes, whenever installed** (it has work to do before its first call)
- Installing it also installs: [Data](Data.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Placement")` on the server

## `GaxiaServer.Placement`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/PlacementService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Placement = GaxiaServer.Placement
```

### Functions

- `Placement.SnapToGrid(worldPos: Vector3, cellSize: number, origin: Vector3?): Vector3`
  Snap a world position to its grid-cell origin.
- `Placement.WorldToCell(plot: Plot, worldPos: Vector3): (number, number)`
  World position → integer cell coords.
- `Placement.CellToWorld(plot: Plot, gx: number, gz: number, footprint: Vector2?): Vector3`
  Cell coords → world position at the CENTRE of the footprint.
- `Placement.AssignPlot(player: Player, plot: Plot): ()`
- `Placement.GetPlot(player: Player): Plot?`
- `Placement.DefineObject(objectId: string, def: ObjectDef): ()`
- `Placement.CanPlace(player: Player, objectId: string, gx: number, gz: number, rot: number?): (boolean, string)`
- `Placement.Place(player: Player, objectId: string, gx: number, gz: number, rot: number?): (string?, string?)`
- `Placement.Remove(player: Player, placementId: string): boolean`
- `Placement.GetPlacements(player: Player): { Placement }`
- `Placement.Rebuild(player: Player): number`
  Replay every saved placement through OnPlace (call on join after data loads; the same OnPlace handler that spawns live placements rebuilds the base).

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Placement.OnPlace` — `Signal<Player, Placement>`
  (player, placement) after Place recorded it; Rebuild replays every saved placement through it
- `Placement.OnRemove` — `Signal<Player, Placement>`
  (player, placement) after Remove deleted it
